title: perf(spec): a bundle that never reads the ADR-0087 conversion table stops keeping it, 226 KB gzip off the console first screen (#22044)
body:
Fixes #22044

Clause-②: no

This is the source-side payback for the maintainer's ruling on objectui#11717. The record is comment `6027998226`, and the selection was 「A 抬预算+回收卡 (Recommended)」. objectui raised its console first-screen budget to let 17.7.0 in (objectui#11742), and this card brings it back down.

**Measured on objectui's console at objectui `c0862c1c`, which resolves 17.7.0:** the first screen's eager closure is **226,238 bytes gzip smaller**, and all of the change is in the `vendor-objectstack` chunk. The 17.7.0 bump added +182,909 bytes gzip to that chunk. No entry's export list changes, and no declaration or runtime value changes. Only the bytes a bundler keeps change.

## What grew between the tags, module by module

**Instrument:** source-map attribution of each published ESM entry file. The tarball ships an `.mjs.map` for each entry, and each generated byte is assigned to the source module of the mapping it falls under. The comparison is npm `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` against `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`. All figures are raw bytes.

**`dist/shared/index.mjs`:** 980,505 to 1,503,348 bytes (+522,843), with the same 79 exports.

| module in `./shared` | 17.6.0 | 17.7.0 | delta |
| --- | --: | --: | --: |
| `src/ui/component.zod.ts` | 277,752 | 395,904 | +118,152 |
| `src/ui/view.zod.ts` | 42,538 | 156,126 | +113,588 |
| `src/data/field.zod.ts` | 11,426 | 122,268 | +110,842 |
| `src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` | 0 | 38,152 | +38,152 |
| `src/conversions/registry.ts` | 357,075 | 391,897 | +34,822 |
| `src/ui/chart.zod.ts` | 0 | 31,088 | +31,088 |
| `src/ui/report.zod.ts` | 0 | 21,701 | +21,701 |
| `src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` | 131 | 17,034 | +16,903 |
| 32 other modules, net | | | +37,595 |

**`dist/browser/index.mjs`** (the root a browser bundler loads): 2,348,750 to 2,593,955 bytes (+245,205).

| module in the browser root | delta |
| --- | --: |
| `src/ui/component.zod.ts` | +118,152 |
| `src/conversions/registry.ts` | +34,822 |
| `src/automation/approval.zod.ts` | +23,623 |
| `src/ai/agent.zod.ts` | +10,024 |
| `src/system/job.zod.ts` | +10,022 |
| `src/ui/chart.zod.ts` | +9,605 |
| `src/ui/page.zod.ts` | +4,549 |
| other modules, net | +34,408 |

**How `./shared` reaches those modules.** This is the esbuild metafile of the 17.7.0 source, shortest path. `shared/index.ts` imports `shared/metadata-collection.zod.ts`, which imports `conversions/apply.ts` (for `normalizeStackInput`). That imports `conversions/registry.ts`, and from there the schemas the conversions read:
- `ui/view.zod.ts`, then `chart.zod.ts` and `bulk-action.zod.ts`;
- through `conversions/walk.ts`: `ui/component.zod.ts`, then `dashboard.zod.ts` and `report.zod.ts`.

`data/field.zod.ts` is also reached through `shared/field-type-suggestion.ts`. The shared source itself grew very little: its own modules are under 10 KB of the delta.

## Why the console kept it

**Every top-level call stays.** Each published entry is one flat file (`tsup.config.ts`, `splitting: false`). A consumer's bundler therefore keeps every top-level call it cannot prove pure, together with everything that call references.

**Two calls build the conversion table at load:**
- `18: inApplicationOrder(MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS)`;
- the `Object.keys(CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR)` chain that flattens into `ALL_CONVERSIONS`.

Unmarked, they kept every conversion, and every schema a conversion reads, in every bundle of every entry whose graph reaches the table. They did so whether or not the bundle reads the table.

**The console never reads the table, and it carried two copies.** In the control's `vendor-objectstack` chunk, each of the 129 conversion ids appears as an `id:` property exactly **2** times: the root's copy and `./shared`'s copy. In the candidate's chunk the count is **0**. That is why the recovery is larger than `./shared`'s growth alone. The table was already in both copies at 17.6.0, and 17.7.0's new conversions made each copy larger.

**Consumer probe.** This probe isolates `./shared` from the rest of the chunk. It is not the acceptance instrument. Setup:
- rolldown 1.0.3, platform browser, minified, gzip -9;
- one bundle per spec entry, importing exactly the names objectui's non-test source at `c0862c1c` value-imports from that entry;
- spec's own source maps chained, so each retained byte is attributed to its module.

| entry | 17.6.0 | 17.7.0 | this head |
| --- | --: | --: | --: |
| `./shared` | 120,147 | 191,561 | **47,491** |
| `./ui` | 132,642 | 165,099 | 165,156 |
| root (browser) | 312,154 | 342,786 | 342,842 |
| `./system` (browser) | 283,598 | 310,749 | 310,794 |
| all 13 entries objectui imports | 1,140,385 | 1,315,136 | 1,171,318 |

- In `./shared` at this head, `src/conversions/registry.ts` keeps 0 bytes, down from 201,720 at 17.7.0.
- The root probe still keeps the table. Its name set includes `defineStack` / `composeStacks`, which `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/core` re-export, but nothing the console bundles calls either of them. The console reading above shows the root's copy gone as well.

## What changed

- **`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`:** both load-time calls carry a `@__PURE__` annotation. The `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` docblock says why, says that the next major's `inApplicationOrder(…)` takes the same mark, and names the pin. No conversion, no order and no value changes.
- **Why source annotations, not the `pure-schema-construction` build plugin.** The plugin marks calls by the name of the callee, everywhere under `src/`. The `ALL_CONVERSIONS` initializer is a `map` / `sort` / `flatMap` chain on `Object.keys`, and marking those names would mark every such call in the package. Two explicit marks on the two calls are the narrowest change. `tsup.config.ts` is untouched, so the chunk layout and the published file set are unchanged (below).
- **Pin:** a new case in `packages/spec/scripts/pure-schema-construction.test.ts`. It builds `./shared` through tsup with the package's own main options, then builds two consumers of that output:
  - the names objectui's console imports from `./shared` keep **none** of the 129 conversion ids;
  - `normalizeStackInput`, the control, keeps **all** of them, which proves the instrument sees the table whenever a bundle keeps it.

  This is a test case, not a gate and not a byte ceiling.
- **`packages/spec/scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts`:** its `WIRING` string, a textual pin of the major-18 wiring line, now spells the annotation.
- **`.changeset/22044-shared-entry-drops-conversion-table.md`:** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. The published bytes change and the contract does not.

## Console reading: the acceptance instrument

objectui `c0862c1c` in a detached worktree, built the way the `Bundle Analysis` job builds it:

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build
```

Each reading comes from `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, which reports gzip bytes.

| build | eager closure gzip | `vendor-objectstack` gzip | `vendor-objectstack` raw | table copies in the chunk |
| --- | --: | --: | --: | --: |
| (a) control: the installed npm 17.7.0 | 3,591,131 | 1,604,474 | 5,399,508 | 2 |
| (b) `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` set to `main` `9a0401fd`, built | 3,591,379 | 1,604,719 | 5,400,408 | not counted |
| (c) `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` set to this head `eb2152b86b`, built | **3,365,141** | **1,378,418** | 4,522,189 | **0** |

- **Recovered, (b) − (c), same injection path and same objectui commit:** 226,238 gzip on the eager closure, and 226,301 gzip / 878,219 raw on `vendor-objectstack`. The other 330 eager chunks moved by +63 gzip net (import-hash churn), and the eager chunk count is 331 in all three builds.
- **Against the published control, (a) − (c):** 225,990 gzip.
- **Repeatability:** (a) and (c) were each built twice and read the same both times.
- **Why `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`:** it is objectui's own injection, the one the Console Pin Gate uses. Reading (b) shows it moves the control by only +248 gzip, which is `main`'s drift since the tag plus the injection path.

## Export parity

The guard is that the export surface does not change. Every comparison below sets `main` `9a0401fd` (built in its own worktree) against this head (built):

- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:api-surface`:** exit 0, "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged ✓".
- **Runtime export lists:** `Object.keys` of every `.mjs` and `.js` file the exports map names, browser arms included. 48 entry files and 7,864 names, **0 differing**. Control leg: npm 17.6.0 against this head reads 16 differing (exit 1).
- **Declaration tree:** compared in the order-insensitive form the `tsup.config.ts` DTS docblock prescribes (sort union members, property-only type-literal members, statements and specifiers; strip chunk hashes; pair chunks by content). 130 files, 38 entries and 62 chunk contents on each side: **identical**. Control leg: npm 17.6.0 against 17.7.0 reads 52 differences (exit 1).
- **Published file set:** `dist/` holds 228 files on both sides, with chunk hashes stripped, and the lists are identical. The chunk layout does not move, so `publish-smoke` is not owed and `needs:pack-smoke` is not needed.
- **Per-entry bytes:** each entry file that carries the table grows by 32 raw bytes, the two annotations. For example, `dist/shared/index.mjs` goes from 1,510,391 to 1,510,423 bytes.

## Verification record

The final head is `eb2152b86b`. Its last commit adds only the changeset, so readings taken at `08392e53a4` cover the same `src/` and `scripts/` tree.

- **Reverse verification of the pin.** Both annotations were committed first, then each was removed in turn through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, at `08392e53a4`:
  - removing the `ALL_CONVERSIONS` mark ("mutation landed", anchor count 1 to 0) turned the pin red, with 129 ids kept against the expected `[]`. Restore: "blob == HEAD (d707d83fdbad) and `git diff HEAD` is empty".
  - removing the `inApplicationOrder` mark turned it red with the 62 major-18 ids kept. Restored the same way.
  - The pin builds from `src/` through tsup, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the assertion.
- **Tests:**

  | suite | head | result |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `@objectstack/spec` local project, full (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`) | `eb2152b86b` | 619 files, 18,486 passed, 1 todo |
  | `scripts/pure-schema-construction.test.ts` | `08392e53a4` | 7 passed (the new case included) |
  | `scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts`, repo project | `08392e53a4` | 12 passed |

  The rest of the `repo` project is declared to CI.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts and test layer) passed at `eb2152b86b`.
- **Build:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (the JS and DTS passes, `check-dts-emitted`, `check-dts-references`) exited 0 at `d017de4582` and at `eb2152b86b`.
- **Gates**, at `eb2152b86b`:
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 86 families. `--ran` reconciles them: 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Every recorded exit code is 0.
  - Three of the 86 first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) and were re-run green after `pnpm turbo run build`: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `@objectstack/lint` `check:doc-formula-expressions`.
  - Also exit 0: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` ("All 15 generated artifacts are up to date").
  - The five families the dispatch's lead list named beyond this derivation also exited 0: `check:authorable-surface`, `check:yaml-examples`, the `check-governed-queue-guard` self-test, `check:console-injection` and `check:console-sha`. The last two skipped for want of `packages/console/dist`, so they are **NOT MEASURED** here.
- **Lint**, narrowed and proven, at `eb2152b86b`:
  - Scope: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed `.ts` files, which is every changed file in eslint's population (`**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`). The changeset is outside it.
  - Result: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - Why the narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full-tree `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **objectui's half.** Lowering the ceiling and `BASELINE` by the recovered amount is objectui's follow-up, once it resolves a release that carries this change. The reading to lower by is the (b) − (c) line above. No objectui commit, branch or PR was made: the objectui worktree was used for measurement only, and was removed.
- **What is left in `./shared` after this change** (consumer probe: 144,609 raw / 47,491 gzip for the console's 5 names). Most of it is argument expressions of calls the build marks pure. A `strictObject({ … })` call is dropped when unused, but arguments that have side effects still run and are kept, for example bare `z.*` chains, `.optional().describe(…)` on an imported schema, and `componentSlot(…)`.
  - The largest remainders: `src/ui/component.zod.ts` 34,556, `src/ui/view.zod.ts` 18,973, `src/data/filter.zod.ts` about 18,000.
  - This is how the build marks construction, not something this card's scope covers. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **Copies across entries.** In the per-entry probe, `src/ui/component.zod.ts` is kept at about 157 to 159 KB raw in each of `./ui`, the root and `./system`, because each flat entry carries its own copy.
  - Whether the console keeps more than one copy is NOT MEASURED: its build emits no module-level map. That would be the shared-chunk route, which redraws the published file set, and the `tsup.config.ts` docblock asks for that review first.
  - Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
